::: {#exr-constant-prediction-decompose-part2}

#### Predicting with one number (part 2)

Use the setup of @exr-constant-prediction-decompose.

Show that
$\E{\sqf{Y - c}} = \Var{Y} + \sqf{\mean - c}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Inside the [square](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#def-square), add and subtract $\mean$.
Then use the [square of a sum](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-sums.html#thm-square-of-a-sum),
[linearity of expectation](expectation.qmd#thm-linearity-expectation),
and the [variance as an expected squared deviation](#thm-variance-expanded).
:::
